The '''Senatorial Council''' was a leadership body of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Its chair was the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="IS">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
